info.name: List triggers for the authenticated organization.

params.name: page
params.description: Gets or sets the page number for pagination (1-based).

params.name: limit
params.description: Gets or sets the number of items per page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Gets or sets the field to sort results by.

params.name: order
params.description: Gets or sets the sort direction.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by enabled status. Omit to return both enabled and disabled triggers.

params.name: type
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by trigger type.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by entity type (e.g. Computers, Sessions).

params.name: isCommon
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by whether the trigger is a built-in (common) trigger. Set to false to return only custom triggers.

params.name: search
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by name. Filter triggers whose name contains the given string. Case-insensitive. Maximum 200 characters.

params.name: include
params.description: Gets or sets optional expansions. 'scope' adds scopeSummary (included/excluded counts) to each trigger item. 'summary' adds top-level aggregate counts by type, enabled status, and common/custom. Can be combined: include=scope&include=summary or include=scope,summary.

params.name: machine
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by machine FQDN or hostname. Cannot be combined with 'folder'. Required when using scopeMatch, resolvedMachines, or perMachine includes. Maximum 512 characters.

params.name: folder
params.description: Gets or sets a filter by folder path. Cannot be combined with 'machine'. Maximum 1024 characters.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of triggers. Supports filtering, sorting, and optional scope-based lookups via the machine or folder parameters.
            
When include=perMachine is specified, the response data array changes shape: instead of trigger items it returns
per-machine groups. The machine or folder parameter is required in that case.
            
Error codes returned in the errorCode field: scope_params_conflict (both machine and folder specified),

info.name: Get full details for a single trigger.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of sections to include: actions, scope, filter, schedule, typeSettings. Omit or leave empty to include all.
